title: Unity 1: Being Together
coreMove: Bring a legitimate shared identity to consciousness before asking for cooperation.
sourcePressure: The source adds unity as a seventh principle and narrows this route to We relationships based on identity, family, genetic commonality, and place.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Unity means being likable, warm, or team-spirited.

hook: An abstract claim that attention changes everything
A generic meeting where someone makes a better pitch
A clever sentence about persuasion before any concrete object appears
counterintuition: You think persuasion happens during the ask, but it happens before it
The obvious factor is not always the important one
Influence is not manipulation when used well
tryThisNow: Set a timer and reflect on attention
Write down three ways to be more persuasive
Ask yourself what matters most right now

exampleSpecs.audience: an archivist asking families to loan fragile letters
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether shared origin is brought forward before the trust request
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the archivist opens with the street name both families left behind before presenting the loan agreement
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a yellowed envelope with an old neighborhood postmark

exampleSpecs.audience: a doctor asking nurses to return to their home county
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether place identity makes the request feel like serving one’s own
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the doctor points to the county birth registry where three applicants’ families appear before discussing shifts
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a county registry open under a clinic lamp

exampleSpecs.audience: an adviser mediating siblings on boat investment
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether family unity is active before the capital decision
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the adviser has each sibling identify the net-mending mark taught by their grandfather before opening the budget
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a repaired net laid across a dock crate

exampleSpecs.audience: a developer asking elders to record pronunciations
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether shared identity precedes technology concerns
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the developer plays a child saying the clan greeting before showing the recording consent form
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a small recorder beside a handwritten greeting card

exampleSpecs.audience: a college officer asking graduates to support flood repairs
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether campus place cues create We before the donation page
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the officer shows the flooded doorway everyone used as freshmen before the gift field
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a photo of a stone campus doorway under floodwater

exampleSpecs.audience: a coordinator asking attendees to share sensitive documents
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a shared journey cue makes trust legitimate before intake

skillTargets: use family or place cues without exploitation
recognize when We language is false

tryThisNowSpec: Before asking for cooperation, write the legitimate We that already exists, then remove any language that would sound like borrowed intimacy.
